## Your questions answered

From the basics to beyond, get info and support on common topics across products.

Expand all Collapse all expand\_all collapse\_all

### What is Google Ads?

add remove

Google Ads is Google’s online advertising program. With Google Ads, you can create online ads to promote your business, help sell your products or services, raise your brand awareness, and increase traffic to your website.

### How much does Google Ads cost?

add remove

Google Ads is a pay-per-click advertising platform, meaning that you only pay when someone clicks on your ad. The cost of your ads will depend on a number of factors, including your industry, your target audience, and the keywords you choose. To learn more about budgeting, visit the [Google Ads Cost page](https://business.google.com/us/google-ads/campaign-budget/).

### What do I need to get started with Google Ads?

add remove

To get started with Google Ads, you’ll need a Google Ads account, a budget, and a website. You’ll also need to choose your campaign goals, ad type, and keywords. Once you’ve set up your account and campaign, you can start running your ads.

### How do I set up a Google Ads account?

add remove

To set up a Google Ads account, first click the “Start now” button on our website. Then, enter your business information like your website URL. After that, choose your campaign goals, upload your creative assets and set your budget. Finally, enter your payment method. Once your account is set up, you can start creating and managing your ads.

### Where can I find expert support?

add remove

To contact a Google Ads expert, schedule a call, or chat live, visit the [Google Ads Expert Support page](https://business.google.com/us/support/ads-expert/).

### Where can I find out even more about Google Ads?

add remove

To find out even more details about the Google Ads product, please visit [Google Ads Help Center](https://support.google.com/google-ads).

Show more

# Getting started with Local Services Ads

With Local Services Ads, you can advertise your business on Google and receive leads directly from potential customers. These leads come in as phone calls and messages sent through your Local Services ad. You can reply to messages, track bookings, and manage all your leads anytime online.

**On this page**

*   [Benefits](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/6224841?hl=en&co=GENIE.CountryCode%3DUS#benefits)
*   [How Local Services Ads work](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/6224841?hl=en&co=GENIE.CountryCode%3DUS#how_lsa_works)
*   [Google Verified Ads](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/6224841?hl=en&co=GENIE.CountryCode%3DUS#verified)
*   [Pre-badge ads](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/6224841?hl=en&co=GENIE.CountryCode%3DUS#pre-badge)
*   [Getting started](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/6224841?hl=en&co=GENIE.CountryCode%3DUS#started)

## Benefits of Local Services Ads

*   Opportunity to feature prominently in Google Search results.
*   Connect with potential customers who are searching for services you provide and are most likely to book.
*   Make use of simple tools to help you get started and create a personalized profile.
*   Inspire confidence with the Google Verified badge ![](//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/xMZpqiPtH89KmmzQ9Ycw6fBjMw3Fpn2xY6IR) (select verticals only).
*   Pay only for leads related to your business and the services you offer.
*   Customers choose you: You only hear from customers who have specifically selected your profile out of all the rest.

* * *

## How Local Services Ads work

The Local Services unit is shown prominently in Google Search results when people search for the services you offer in areas you've chosen. Potential customers can click or tap on your ad to either call you or send you a message request. They can also [schedule a booking](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/9905231) with you directly through your ad. Learn how to [Manage leads and jobs](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/6224859) (US only).

When a customer reaches out, you'll get an email. From this point on, the lead is yours to turn into a customer.

To ensure you continue to receive messages, respond to as many of them as you can (even if you decline to provide the requested service). If you regularly fail to answer calls or respond to messages, your ad ranking may be affected.

**Note**: Booking leads aren't available for health care verticals.

* * *

## Google Verified Ads

The Google Verified badge helps inspire confidence by signaling to consumers that your business has passed Google’s proprietary screening process.

Provider profiles display the Google Verified badge along with the specific verification checks they have completed.

On your Local Services profile page, you will find the Google Verified badge ![](//storage.googleapis.com/support-kms-prod/xMZpqiPtH89KmmzQ9Ycw6fBjMw3Fpn2xY6IR) next to the name of your business or featured professionals. Learn more [About Google Verified badge](https://support.google.com/localservices/answer/16498018).

**Note**: The Google Verified badge is currently unavailable for verticals in the auto, beauty, and dining categories.

* * *

## Pre-badge ads

Google also offers pre-badge ads that allow you to receive leads from Local Services Ads after you’ve passed the preliminary checks and while you’re completing the remaining required onboarding checks. As a reminder, you’ll still need to complete all onboarding requirements to go live with the Google Verified badge.

### Requirements to go live with pre-badge ads

*   License, or business registration, if you’re not required to submit your license
*   Acknowledge possession of all appropriate business licenses
*   Reviews, subject to category requirements
*   Complete billing setup and set your budget

### Requirements to go live with pre-badge ads for professional verticals

*   License, or business registration, if you’re not required to submit your license (in the US)
*   Business registration (in the UK)
*   Headshots
*   Reviews, subject to category requirements
*   Complete billing setup and set your budget

With pre-badge ads, your Local Services listing will appear in consumer search results. However, Google will place the listing below providers who’ve completed all onboarding requirements and obtained the Google Badge.

**Note**: Pre-badge ads aren't available for garage door services, health care verticals, and locksmiths. 

* * *

## Getting started with Local Services Ads

At this time, Local Services Ads are available only for certain service categories.

To check if Local Services Ads are available in your area, check your business eligibility.

[Check eligibility](https://ads.google.com/local-services-ads/?subid=ww-ww-et-hc-gls-a-ckel_z!o2#!/)
